thread:
alex: quick thought — we should formalize a "safe rollout" runtime config pattern for feature flags and routing rules. idea: require schema validation + automated percent-based ramp with telemetry gates.

sophia: totally. do you mean build it into the config service or just add conventions/docs?

alex: config service + console UX. default schema + validators in API so bad formats fail fast. plus a tiny state machine: START -> RAMP -> MONITOR -> FULL -> ROLLBACK.

ranjit: why not reuse the existing flag infra? we already have percentage rollouts but no telemetry gating. adding gates would need metric hooks and health thresholds.

jamie: +1 to metric hooks. we need an opinionated set of health signals: 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, token cost delta. if any exceed threshold during RAMP, auto-bump to ROLLBACK and notify oncall.

maria: from product: keep controls for releases shorter than 24h by default. PMs want a "quick revert" button in console. also need audit trail.

chris: implementation sketch:
```
rollout:
  id: rl-2026-09
  target: route:v2-model
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 10m
      gates:
        - name: 5xx_rate
          threshold: 0.5%
        - name: p95_latency_ms
          threshold: 220
    - pct: 25
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 100
      duration: 1h
```
The config API returns validation errors if unknown gate names or missing metric bindings.

alex: exactly. console should show live gate statuses and a "pause/rollback" CTA. also surface the expected cost delta per-step.

ranjit: operational concern: we need a read-after-write guarantee for flag reads during rollout so split-brain doesn't send mixed traffic. can we use monotonic config versions + small GC window?

jamie: we can do version pinning per-routing decision. runtime will prefer pinned version for X seconds, then switch. avoids partial reads.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled job: validate-schema for new runtime-configs every 5m — next run in 3m :gear:

chris: telemetry question: who binds metrics to gates? infra or teams? My vote: infra provides standard metrics and teams can supply custom eval metrics via eval endpoints. tie by metric name in rollout config.

maria: decision: infra owns baseline metrics (latency, 5xx, cost) and teams can opt-in custom gates. product will draft UX copy for console + audit fields.

alex: ok next steps: 1) chris/ranjit to prototype API + validation library, 2) jamie to propose gate set and auto-rollback thresholds, 3) sophia + maria to design console flows and revert button, 4) ops to add deploy-bot lint rule. sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:

sophia: noted. I'll mock a console flow in Figma by EOD.

ranjit: starting API sketch now, will push WIP to branch: feat/rollout-gates.

jamie: will write RFC for gate thresholds and failure modes.

maria: adding to roadmap and telling PMs.

alex: thanks all — keeping this thread for brief updates only, move implementation chatter to the PR.
